thread.title: Justice Department looking into whether AT&T, Verizon are hampering switching carriers: report - MarketWatch

author: Steve Goldstein
title: Justice Department looking into whether AT&T, Verizon are hampering switching carriers: report - MarketWatch
text: The Justice Department has opened an antitrust investigation into AT&T T, -0.43% Verizon Communications VZ, -1.09% and a telecommunications standards organization, the GSMA, over whether they hindered consumers from easily switching wireless carriers, The New York Times reported , citing six people with knowledge of the inquiry. The report said the government was looking into whether they thwarted a new technology that would allow people to switch providers without having to insert a new SIM card into a device. The report said device makers including Apple AAPL, -4.10% Google GOOG, -1.36% and Microsoft MSFT, -1.15% support the technology.
